provenance.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one full-body native right-facing profile drawing for the reusable prehistoric actor Lila; an animation source candidate, not a character redesign or an animation frame sheet.
Input images: Image1 is the PRIMARY identity, exact face/hair/clothing/limb/proportion/color reference. Image2 is SUPPLEMENTAL only for the drawn world's line style and anatomical view logic; never use its white face or simplified costume instead of Image1.
Primary request: redraw ONLY Lila from Image1 as a genuine side-on profile facing SCREEN RIGHT, standing at rest, head and torso both facing right. One eye visible on the near side, nose protruding right and a small friendly closed smile on the correct face plane. Do not show a frontal face or a third eye. Draw the same person and preserve the entire warm peach-orange skin and brown source shading.
Invariants: exact recognizable tousled dark-brown silhouette, low tied long hair/ponytail and trailing long hair, brown tie, asymmetrical one-shoulder brown fur hide dress with the visible bare shoulder belonging to the same anatomical side as in Image1, braided waist belt and one continuous jagged skirt (not shorts), thick smooth BLACK stick arms and legs, black thumbed mitten hands and large black rounded feet, all in the source proportions. Preserve black hand/foot silhouettes and warm saturated hair/dress/skin values. Preserve the rough lively hand-drawn ink contour and warm painted texture; no vector-flat polygon treatment. Do not add flowers, jewellery, sleeves, footwear, extra fingers or props.
Pose: relaxed plausible shoulders, two arms with gentle natural curvature resting down, no sharply reversed elbow, no compressed upper arm. Two legs of source-consistent length with both large soles flat on the same baseline and modest near/far offset so the two legs and feet remain readable in profile. Head attached naturally to neck without a second neck, chin deformation or facial shear. No leaned running pose. Proper side-view depth/occlusion of far arm/leg.
Composition: one isolated full character, from complete hair tips to both soles, centered with generous transparent margin on ALL sides, large enough to inspect facial ink and garment silhouette. Real transparent RGBA background, no beige patch, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no ground shadow. No text, sheet, grid, panels, borders, leaves or environment.
Color: use Image1's rich dark chocolate hair, warm medium-earth brown hide, orange-peach face and black limbs. Clear warm light/shadow and lively non-pale saturation. Preserve natural two-dimensional storybook rendering.
Change only viewpoint into a newly authored right profile. Do not mirror or warp the frontal reference.

reviewNotes: Hai bàn chân có chênh nền trong bản v1; giữ nguyên nguồn làm edit-target/provenance cho v2, không dùng v1 làm pose đứng đạt.
Góc yêu cầu là profile phải; chưa đo yaw/landmark, tỷ lệ/identity/texture/alpha/sole/contact chưa nghiệm thu.
